lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in a structured 2D grid along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating clearly defined anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily at the base and mid-section of the first dorsal fin, with a sparse arrangement toward the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent semicircular indentation/tissue loss on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin; additional irregular scarring visible on the upper flank near the dorsal base.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spiral-like dark pigmentation pattern located at the posterior insertion point of the first dorsal fin.
